ChatLevel.description:
Owner-granted Chat AI level of one workspace. `Off` is the default: nothing
chat-related enters the ceiling or the publication.

ChatThreadUpdateParams.description: Omitted fields stay unchanged; `effort: null` clears it back to the provider default.

oneOf.description: New devices get read access at once; control waits for the code.
Every new device waits for the owner.

LocalShellIntegration.description:
Typed description of an ordinary discovered shell. Its fields are local
configuration only; remote RPC still selects a registered profile ID.

oneOf.description:
A bounded generic WSL shell whose exact absolute path is carried in
the adjacent descriptor. Native profiles keep unknown executables on
the legacy launch path instead.

LocalStartMode.description: Saved local preference only. It does not install or start an OS service.

SnapshotEncoding.description:
Opt-in snapshot wire encodings. Absent keeps the full-width row encoding
that older clients require; older Hosts reject the field entirely.

oneOf.description: Rows omit trailing blank default cells; decoders pad them back.

trimmed-rows-v1 plus cells that omit default-valued fields (text " ",
width 1, default colors, no flags, underline or hyperlink), in
snapshots and in every state delta. Decoders restore the defaults.
